verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes provide isolated, ephemeral environments (with filesystem access, networking controls, snapshots) explicitly designed for running untrusted/agent code separate from production, which supports sandbox-based testing without touching production systems. However, evidence is entirely vendor docs plus tangential community use-cases (CI runners, agent JS runtime) rather than explicit testing-against-production-safe-data workflows or first-party guidance on data isolation from prod specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation/testing scenario tying sandbox use to protecting production data, independent verification of data isolation guarantees, and concrete user testimonials about avoiding production impact.
